argv: Explore carousel (EC1-EC20, decision 0124; discrete navigation DN1, DN10, DN12, DN13)
ops.body:
- [ ] **Do:** start a walk on a phone; open its Layers panel, switch Places on, walk toward a place, then switch Places off and on again. **Expect:** a fresh walk draws no "?"; with Places on the "?" and the range ring (while the settings are up) draw and a pocket alert buzzes if set; off, they go; the walk's panel and options card list Places, and no Quiet / Explore choice exists on the start drawer or the walk. (MD1-MD4, MD7, MD13)
- [ ] **Do:** turn Places on and off during a walk past two places, then watch its replay. **Expect:** the replay names "Passed X without stopping" only for a place passed while Places was on; a walk that never had it on names none. (MD9)

- The replay reads the current "What I'm into" kinds when it names what a walk passed, so a later change of kinds rewrites an old replay; only the pass distance is frozen per walk (`walk_pass:<walk>`, decision 0224). Surfaced by the modes-to-layers steward (S2, Nov 19) and left as it was: freezing the kinds per walk would be a new stored value.

- Walk-screen UI review of modes-to-layers (Nov 19): the open Layers panel covers a third of the map where a toggled layer's result appears (U4), and "Storefronts" names both a route leaning in Walk settings and a map layer in the panel, so a choice made in one reads as lost in the other (U5). Both are older than the slice; a distinct route label ("Shopping streets") and a panel that stays out of the result's way would fix them, shown by screenshots.
